embedder.description: The pinned embedder (BC-P2-30): policy pin (id, version = the executed revision, dimensions, source) plus the executed component identity — identity (portable digest over adapter, model artefact and runtime identity), adapter (builtin, or plugin id / revision / descriptor and implementation hashes), model (id, revision, content sha256, artefact count), runtime (id, kind). Part of the hashed core: a change of any portable component makes the index incompatible.

reranker.description: The pinned reranker: provider, version (the executed revision), pinned_version (the policy pin; '0' names none) and the same component identity as the embedder. Not part of the hashed core (it changes no stored index state); bound at query time.

components.description: Outside the hashed core: per component (embedder, reranker) the full adapter, model artefact list (repository-relative path and sha256) and the inference runtime's content hash on the machine that built the index (machine-specific).

retrieval_profile.description: Outside the hashed core: the profile digest and its governance state at build time (KERNEL_DEFAULT | GOVERNED | GOVERNED_UNVERIFIED | UNGOVERNED | UNGOVERNED_CHANGE) with the governing decision.
